title_en: Villa Residence Habitat Mjull-Bathore for sale
description_en: Individual villas for sale in Residence "Habitat", Mjull-Bathore. If you are looking to live in a super villa on the outskirts of Tirana, in peace and clean air, we have an excellent option for you. The villa is located in a super new residential complex, recently built in the area of ​​Mjull-Bathore in Tirana, with 10 attached villas and 2 individual villas. Each of the villas has dedicated parking and an elevator that connects the villa from the garage to its 2nd floor. The residence where it is located offers a common pool and recreational facilities for residents. It is also equipped with a security system, with guards and cameras.
